new.brief: Creates a new `GtkBookmarkList` with the given `attributes`.
new.md: Creates a new `GtkBookmarkList` with the given `attributes`.

doc.md:
A list model that wraps `GBookmarkFile`.

It presents a `GListModel` and fills it asynchronously with the
`GFileInfo`s returned from that function.

The `GFileInfo`s in the list have some attributes in the recent
namespace added: `recent::private` (boolean) and `recent:applications`
(stringv).

get_attributes.brief: Gets the attributes queried on the children.
get_attributes.md: Gets the attributes queried on the children.

get_filename.brief: Returns the filename of the bookmark file that this list is loading.
get_filename.md:
Returns the filename of the bookmark file that
this list is loading.

get_io_priority.brief: Gets the IO priority to use while loading file.
get_io_priority.md: Gets the IO priority to use while loading file.

is_loading.brief: Returns `TRUE` if the files are currently being loaded.
is_loading.md:
Returns `TRUE` if the files are currently being loaded.

Files will be added to `self` from time to time while loading is
going on. The order in which are added is undefined and may change
in between runs.

set_attributes.brief: Sets the `attributes` to be enumerated and starts the enumeration.
set_attributes.md:
Sets the `attributes` to be enumerated and starts the enumeration.

If `attributes` is `NULL`, no attributes will be queried, but a list
of `GFileInfo`s will still be created.

set_io_priority.brief: Sets the IO priority to use while loading files.
set_io_priority.md:
Sets the IO priority to use while loading files.

The default IO priority is %G_PRIORITY_DEFAULT.
